title: MNIST: inside a convolutional network
description: Follow a handwritten digit through learned filters, pooling and classification.
alt: A native ManimML CNN with upright translucent channel planes, orange receptive-field volumes, pooling layers, a 392-value vector, ten dense neurons and softmax probabilities. Layer shapes and measured values accompany the network.

requirements.description: Use the existing verified trained 4266-parameter CNN and real MNIST test image0,target7. Keep all displayed metrics and selected activation values tied to the immutable trace; distinguish schematic plane colors from numerical activations.

Use actual ManimML Convolutional2DLayer, MaxPooling2DLayer, FeedForwardLayer and Filters primitives. Keep upright native channel planes, shrinking pooling geometry, a392-value vector, ten dense neurons and output bars visible as one dominant architecture throughout. No tilted raster thumbnail stacks or separate gallery strips.

Animate coupled gridded receptive fields and orange input-to-output volumes. Conv1 scans a padded input window; Conv2 spans all four incoming channels. Pooling maps each selected channel independently with stride2. Validate runtime geometry and correct live coordinate/activation readouts.

Show layer tensor shapes and kernel/stride settings above the matching layers; display actual parameter counts, maxima, selected responses, winning logit, confidence, sample cross-entropy and full-test accuracy. All math uses LaTeX.

Black-background1080p30H264 video, native vector geometry with readable labels and Arial-family prose, smooth focused motion, safe projected camera bounds, initial/final reading holds, full-network thumbnail and brief website description. Inspect the actual render and desktop/mobile player before deployment.
